convergences.thesis: Short-video e-commerce has trained a generation to buy from a person, not a page. AI-generated content plus AR filters collapse the cost of producing that person to near zero, while local boutiques remain unable to produce it at all.
Gig-economy side hustles have outgrown formal marketplaces at the neighbourhood tier, where trust is proximity-based and ticket sizes are too small to survive marketplace take rates.
